description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for the media_library module, including help text, source info alteration, view pre/post render modifications, form alterations, local task adjustments, and access control for image styles.

classes.name: MediaLibraryHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for the media_library module, including help, source info, view, form, task, and access hooks.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the media_library module, including descriptions of features and customization options.

methods.name: mediaSourceInfoAlter
methods.description: Alters media source info to add forms for media types if missing.

methods.name: viewsPreRender
methods.description: Modifies view classes before rendering, adding CSS classes for media library views.

methods.name: viewsPostRender
methods.description: Post-processing after view rendering, attaching libraries and handling query parameters for media library views.

methods.name: formAlter
methods.description: Alters forms, including views exposed forms and media type forms, for accessibility and configuration.

methods.name: formViewsFormMediaLibraryPageAlter
methods.description: Alters the media library bulk form to add accessible labels.

methods.name: fieldUiPreconfiguredOptionsAlter
methods.description: Sets default widget for media entity reference fields to media_library_widget.

methods.name: localTasksAlter
methods.description: Removes media library tasks if the associated routes no longer exist.

methods.name: imageStyleAccess
methods.description: Prevents deletion of the 'media_library' image style.
